common_interface.reset: synchronous active-low aresetn resets only the read-output pipeline and never clears memory contents
common_interface.address_unit: native words of the corresponding port, never byte addresses
common_interface.out_of_range_policy: suppress the physical enable in synthesized hardware and report an error in simulation

bram_bank.capacity_rule: WRITE_DATA_WIDTH*WRITE_DEPTH must divide exactly by READ_DATA_WIDTH
bram_bank.width_ratio_rule: one port width must be an integer multiple of the other

uram_bank.resource_rule: each design must override DEPTH from bank_layout and verify aggregate URAM use

latency_policy.rule: BRAM and URAM expose the same cycle contract; a design may override it only as one shared bank-pool parameter and must reverify all consumers

replacement_scope.integration_fixture: ip/infrastructure/datamover_engine/tb/integration_bank.sv must instantiate bram_bank instead of a behavioral memory array for the default XSIM path

required_verification: BRAM symmetric and asymmetric port widths
BRAM default mapping to RAMB primitives and zero URAM
Vivado 2025.2 OOC synthesis for both default modules at 5 ns
